question: On 5 August 2024, which individual, along with top military officials, met former Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina at Ghaziabad's Hindon Airbase?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Ajit Doval**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ajit Doval** is the **National Security Advisor (NSA) of India**, a position he has held since **2014**.
 
• He is a former Indian Police Service (IPS) officer from the **1968 batch of the Kerala cadre**.
 
• Ajit Doval is considered one of India's most prominent security strategists and has played a key role in shaping India's **national security policies**.
 
• He has been instrumental in dealing with **counter-terrorism measures**, strategic diplomacy, and ensuring the safety of Indian interests domestically and internationally.
 
• On **5 August 2024**, Ajit Doval, along with top military officials, met former Bangladeshi Prime Minister **Sheikh Hasina** at Hindon Airbase, Ghaziabad. This meeting is significant as it highlights India's **strategic engagement** with Bangladesh, a key South Asian neighbor.
 
• The meeting underscores India's commitment to strengthening bilateral ties with Bangladesh, especially in areas of **security cooperation**, economic collaboration, and regional stability.
 
• Ajit Doval's presence in the meeting reflects the importance of **security and diplomatic discussions** at the highest level between the two nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Manoj Gupta** is not known for any high-profile diplomatic or military engagement between India and Bangladesh.
 
• The name might refer to another individual but lacks relevance in the given context.
 
 
 
• **Shivshankar Menon**__
 
 
• **Shivshankar Menon** served as India's **National Security Advisor (NSA)** from **2010 to 2014** under the UPA government.
 
• He is a career diplomat and has held roles such as **Foreign Secretary** and ambassador to various countries.
 
• Although he played a crucial role in shaping India's foreign policy, he was not part of the meeting at Hindon Airbase on **5 August 2024**.
